question: Did you read our patch management procedure, or just the standard?
answer: No, the material does not contain a statement from the operator confirming they read the patch management procedure. The operator's comment in [isection-440a5cdf9a6b65292ef3] is an internal justification for their own strictness, not a statement of having read the procedure. The material only shows the operator's intentional strictness on CIP-007-6 R2 Part 2.2 and their rationale for evaluating patches every 30 days instead of the 35 days allowed by the standard.
